scripts.deploy: node -e "console.error('Production deployment is available only through the approved GitHub Actions workflow.'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.deploy:production: node -e "console.error('Production deployment is available only through the approved GitHub Actions workflow.'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.upload:production:candidate: node -e "console.error('Production version uploads are disabled while Durable Object export provisioning is unresolved.'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.deploy:staging: node -e "console.error('Staging deployment is available only through the approved GitHub Actions workflow.'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run verify && npm run secrets:check:preview && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.preview.jsonc && npm run secrets:check:preview
scripts.test:worker-runtime: vitest run --config vitest.worker.config.ts && vitest run --config vitest.staging.config.ts && vitest run --config vitest.preview.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run test:e2e:built
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:built
scripts.config:check: wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.jsonc --outdir .wrangler/dry-run/production && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.staging.jsonc --outdir .wrangler/dry-run/staging && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.preview.jsonc --outdir .wrangler/dry-run/preview
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:worker-runtime && npm run notices:check && npm run build && npm run test:built && npm run test:worker-runtime && npm run test:e2e:built && npm run types:check && npm run config:check
